name: hero
description: First section above the fold. Establishes brand + offer + primary CTA in a single glance.
intent: Make the visitor know which brand they're on, what's being offered, and where to click, in under 5 seconds.
whenToUse: As the first section of any landing page. Not a content divider, heroes are the page's opening statement.

eyebrow.description: Sub-heading above the main title. Usually the product name or a 3-word positioner.

title.description: The single biggest statement on the page. Usually 4-8 words.

supporting.description: One-sentence explanation of who it's for + what they get. 15-30 words.

primaryCta.description: Button label + href. Language varies by brand (Apply vs Start vs Discover).

secondaryCta.description: Optional link below the primary (e.g., 'See the curriculum' or 'Listen to the podcast').

image.description: Brand photography. For Tracy: portrait. For FFB: warm editorial. For FFM: high-polish editorial. For FRESH: lifestyle + pillar iconography.

layout.splitRight: Image right, copy left. Default for FFB, FFM.
layout.splitLeft: Image left, copy right. Alternate for editorial feel.
layout.stacked: Full-width image + centred copy below. For FRESH multi-pillar content.
layout.textOnly: No image, centred copy + space. For Tracy's editorial minimalism.

avoid: Multiple competing CTAs. One primary, optionally one secondary.
Stock photography that doesn't feature Tracy or real members.
